coordinate_contract: 0-based half-open; fixed linear clipped neighborhoods; no origin wrap
primary_protein_source: Audited official protein.faa records without retranslation

orf_branch.scope: whole genome for all 174 accessions, then map to unchanged 383 neighborhoods
orf_branch.role: NC_138483.1 rescue plus separate all174 annotation-gap sensitivity; not a replacement for official proteins
orf_branch.translation_table: record model-selected table from Prodigal; do not force an unsupported code
orf_branch.acceptance: CDS nucleotide must match exact genomic interval in predicted coding direction; no internal stop replacement
orf_branch.alternative_code_limitation: Meta mode may miss recoded or otherwise unusual phage genes; no negative biological calls

rt_scan.profile_snapshot: download only these three official Pfam HMMs; freeze ACC.version, GA values and SHA256 before scoring
rt_scan.primary: hmmsearch --cut_ga; an included domain in RVT_1 or RVT_2 is profile-level RT evidence, not catalytic or ART proof
rt_scan.auxiliary: RVT_3 alone is RT-like auxiliary evidence, not sufficient for the RT_CORE label
rt_scan.deduplication: exact amino acid SHA256 for computation only; restore all official/ORF records and candidate links
rt_scan.background: one combined, frozen target universe; no data-dependent database reduction
rt_scan.absence_interpretation: NO_HIT_IN_THIS_PROFILE_PANEL, never RT absent or non-ART

repeat_survey.scope: all 383 fixed neighborhoods independent of RT hits and scores
repeat_survey.selection: each exact seed occurrence cluster; deterministic greedy nonoverlap; maximal common exact extension within the core limit
repeat_survey.low_complexity: retain and label; do not promote to high-complexity evidence
repeat_survey.redundancy: merge contained shifted representations with equal copy counts; preserve source-seed multiplicity
repeat_survey.noncoding_label: NO_OFFICIAL_CDS_OVERLAP is annotation-relative, not proven ncRNA; require full array span and all repeat copies to be checked
repeat_survey.predicted_orf_overlap: separate predicted-CDS mask; absence of annotation never establishes absence of a gene
repeat_survey.limits: exact-core, direct-repeat, finite-distance survey; not an exhaustive imperfect-repeat finder; no RNA expression or function inferred

integration.retention: all 383 candidates and all original fields in original order
integration.primary_evidence: RT_CORE_GA plus exact-core-repeat context, reported as separate columns
integration.cooccurrence: candidate-neighborhood co-occurrence only; report physical RT-array distance and candidate overlap
integration.partner: adjacent ORF/CDS inventory is a potential-neighbor inventory, never a dedicated-partner claim
integration.mature_peptides: retain parent relationship; do not count processed products as independent genes
integration.novelty: NOT_ASSESSED; no ART identity or novelty call from this stage
